content.biome.chip-canyons.desc: Cliffs of stacked potato chips. Crabs scuttle in the cracks.
content.biome.chip-canyons.name: Chip Canyons
content.biome.coin-laundromat.desc: Rows of washers hum in an empty field. Nobody knows who pays the power bill.
content.biome.coin-laundromat.name: Coin Laundromat
content.biome.compost-caves.desc: Damp tunnels under the compost heap. Spore vents sting.
content.biome.compost-caves.name: Compost Caves
content.biome.crop-circle.desc: Wheat pressed flat in perfect rings. Something landed here and left its crew behind.
content.biome.crop-circle.name: Crop Circle
content.biome.duchess-gardens.desc: A clipped hedge maze of jade lawns and grey gravel walks. The Court holds its audience here.
content.biome.duchess-gardens.name: Duchess Gardens
content.biome.frozen-tundra.desc: A frozen plain of fries. Frost patches chill Tibo.
content.biome.frozen-tundra.name: Frozen-Fries Tundra
content.biome.fry-oil-desert.desc: Hot sand and pools of fryer oil that burn.
content.biome.fry-oil-desert.name: Fry-Oil Desert
content.biome.fry-palace.desc: A drive-thru alone in the wild, still open. Gulls and raccoons rule the parking lot.
content.biome.fry-palace.name: Fry Palace Drive-Thru
content.biome.gutterball-lanes.desc: A bowling alley with no walls and no roof. The lanes are still oiled and the pins still stand.
content.biome.gutterball-lanes.name: Gutterball Lanes
content.biome.ketchup-bog.desc: A hot red marsh. Puddles of ketchup burn and slow.
content.biome.ketchup-bog.name: Ketchup Bog
content.biome.mash-swamp.desc: Knee-deep mashed potato. It slows Tibo down.
content.biome.mash-swamp.name: Mash Swamp
content.biome.peel-forest.desc: Trees with bark like potato peel. Thorny brambles scratch.
content.biome.peel-forest.name: Peel Forest
content.biome.potato-field.desc: Neat rows of potato plants. Where every run starts.
content.biome.potato-field.name: Potato Field
content.biome.roast-caldera.desc: Pale ash over a cooling caldera, cut by narrow channels of slow lava. The Shell's armoured beasts wade through it.
content.biome.roast-caldera.name: Roast Caldera
content.biome.russet-moor.desc: A misty moor of heather, standing stones and a ruined windmill. The packs hunt here.
content.biome.russet-moor.name: Russet Moor
content.biome.vinegar-shoals.desc: Golden tidal flats of wet sand and sour pools. Things burrow under the shallows.
content.biome.vinegar-shoals.name: Vinegar Shoals
content.boss.amusing.desc: The potato festival's fluffy pink mascot. He waves hello, throws hearts and stuffing, then leaps in for a hug that squeezes the starch out of you.
content.boss.amusing.name: amusing
content.boss.amusing.title: The Festival Mascot
content.boss.beetle-queen.desc: The striped potato beetle queen. Her brood hatches in a ring around Tibo.
content.boss.beetle-queen.name: Colorado Queen
content.boss.beetle-queen.title: Mother of Beetles
content.boss.compost-titan.desc: A heap of rotting leaves and mulch. Maggots pour out of it.
content.boss.compost-titan.name: Compost Titan
content.boss.compost-titan.title: The Rot Heap
content.boss.deep-freezer.desc: A walking chest freezer. Its ice cubes freeze you for a moment.
content.boss.deep-freezer.name: The Deep Freezer
content.boss.deep-freezer.title: Keeper of Frozen Fries
content.boss.fryer-king.desc: A crowned deep fryer. It spits rings of boiling oil.
content.boss.fryer-king.name: The Fryer King
content.boss.fryer-king.title: Lord of the Hot Oil
content.boss.grater-golem.desc: A box grater on legs. It charges along a marked line.
content.boss.grater-golem.name: Grater Golem
content.boss.grater-golem.title: The Shredder
content.boss.great-wireworm.desc: A huge wireworm. It burrows and bursts up under Tibo.
content.boss.great-wireworm.name: The Great Wireworm
content.boss.great-wireworm.title: Borer of Tubers
content.boss.harvester.desc: A combine harvester. It charges down long lanes. Every potato's last fear.
content.boss.harvester.name: The Harvester
content.boss.harvester.title: End of the Season
content.boss.ketchup-kraken.desc: A kraken of ketchup. Its tentacles slam down in a pattern.
content.boss.ketchup-kraken.name: Ketchup Kraken
content.boss.ketchup-kraken.title: Terror of the Bog
content.boss.late-blight.desc: A creeping cloud of blight. Spore clouds bloom where it points.
content.boss.late-blight.name: Late Blight
content.boss.late-blight.title: The Famine Fog
content.boss.pack-lord.desc: A giant alpha that runs the packs. It leaps in chained lunges and calls its hunters, and every pack scatters when it falls.
content.boss.pack-lord.name: Pack Lord
content.boss.pack-lord.title: Leader of the Hunt
content.boss.queen.desc: Her three attendants guard her from every blow, and return when left fallen.
content.boss.queen.name: The Queen
content.boss.queen.title: The Island Court
content.boss.root-hydra-frenzy.desc: Five heads, red-eyed and wounded. It lunges.
content.boss.root-hydra-frenzy.name: The Root Hydra
content.boss.root-hydra-frenzy.title: Five Heads
content.boss.root-hydra-head.desc: One of the Hydra's heads bursts from the ground, spits mud and sinks again. Every hit it takes now weakens the Hydra at 29:00.
content.boss.root-hydra-head.name: Root Hydra Head
content.boss.root-hydra-head.title: Burrowing
content.boss.root-hydra-mire.desc: Two heads dive into the ground and spit mud pools across the field.
content.boss.root-hydra-mire.name: The Root Hydra
content.boss.root-hydra-mire.title: Pools
content.boss.root-hydra-stump.desc: Its middle head falls. Mud Golems crawl out of the ground.
content.boss.root-hydra-stump.name: The Root Hydra
content.boss.root-hydra-stump.title: Stump
content.boss.root-hydra.desc: A root-crusted hydra that bursts from the ground. Its three heads bite down in lanes.
content.boss.root-hydra.name: The Root Hydra
content.boss.root-hydra.title: Three Heads
content.boss.shell-titan.desc: Its three plates open in order after each charge. Break through while one is exposed.
content.boss.shell-titan.name: The Shell Titan
content.boss.shell-titan.title: Three Plates
content.boss.sir-strawman.desc: A scarecrow knight. It throws fans of sharp straw.
content.boss.sir-strawman.name: Sir Strawman
content.boss.sir-strawman.title: Guardian of the Rows
content.boss.the-mandoline.desc: A living mandoline slicer. Its blade sweeps across in lanes.
content.boss.the-mandoline.name: The Mandoline
content.boss.the-mandoline.title: Slicer of Fries
content.boss.the-masher.desc: A giant potato masher. It slams where Tibo stands.
content.boss.the-masher.name: The Masher
content.boss.the-masher.title: Kitchen Enforcer
content.botHelp.bubbler.desc: Wraps Tibo in a bubble for a moment and patches him up.
content.botHelp.bubbler.name: Bubble Bot
content.botHelp.gifter.desc: Drops a handful of coins, a gem worth part of a level, and now and then a Bot Beacon.
content.botHelp.gifter.name: Gift Bot
content.botHelp.tidier.desc: Sweeps every nearby gem and coin over to Tibo.
content.botHelp.tidier.name: Tidy Bot
content.botHelp.zapper.desc: Zaps the closest bugs. Elites only get a jolt, and bosses are too big to zap.
content.botHelp.zapper.name: Zapper Bot
content.dailyWeather.aurora.desc: Every 25 seconds an aurora makes experience worth triple and doubles Tibo's pickup reach. Tibo starts deep in the Potato Field.
content.dailyWeather.aurora.name: Aurora
content.dailyWeather.blizzard.desc: A blizzard blows all run. Tibo grows colder away from the campfires and slows as he freezes, and a campfire warms him back up. Tibo starts deep in the Frozen Tundra.
content.dailyWeather.blizzard.name: Blizzard
content.dailyWeather.bloodmoon.desc: Elites come twice as often and hit harder, and each one drops triple experience and coins. Tibo starts deep in the Mash Swamp.
content.dailyWeather.bloodmoon.name: Blood Moon
content.dailyWeather.drop.desc: Pests fall from the sky around Tibo instead of walking in, and a shadow on the ground shows where each one will land.
content.dailyWeather.drop.name: Pest Drop
content.dailyWeather.echo.desc: Every third hit from Tibo's weapons echoes a moment later and strikes every pest close to it. Tibo starts deep in the Peel Forest.
content.dailyWeather.echo.name: Echo Day
content.dailyWeather.eclipse.desc: Only a ring of light stays around Tibo. Pests inside it take more damage, and pests outside it show only their eyes. Tibo starts deep in the Compost Caves.
content.dailyWeather.eclipse.name: Eclipse
content.dailyWeather.fog.desc: Fog fills the Compost Caves. Pests and bosses that lose Tibo in the fog creep along until they come close, and Tibo starts deep in the caves.
content.dailyWeather.fog.name: Thick Fog
content.dailyWeather.hail.desc: Hail pelts the pests near Tibo every moment, hurting and knocking back every pest and boss a stone lands on, and Tibo starts deep in the Peel Forest.
content.dailyWeather.hail.name: Hailstorm
content.dailyWeather.heat.desc: Heat shimmers all run, burning ground spreads twice as often, and Tibo starts deep in the Fry-Oil Desert.
content.dailyWeather.heat.name: Heatwave
content.dailyWeather.meteors.desc: Meteors fall on the thickest crowds near Tibo, and each crater slows the pests inside it for a while. Tibo starts deep in the Chip Canyons.
content.dailyWeather.meteors.name: Meteor Shower
content.dailyWeather.migration.desc: Every minute a herd of beetles charges across the map in a straight band, and each beetle drops rich experience. Tibo starts deep in the Peel Forest.
content.dailyWeather.migration.name: Migration
content.dailyWeather.night.desc: Night falls all run, pests and bosses rush in faster from the dark outside Tibo's light, and Tibo starts deep in the Potato Field.
content.dailyWeather.night.name: Long Night
content.dailyWeather.rain.desc: Rain falls all run, mud puddles spread twice as often and wider, and Tibo starts deep in the Mash Swamp.
content.dailyWeather.rain.name: Downpour
content.dailyWeather.rings.desc: Rings of sprouting potatoes dot the ground, and Tibo's weapons fire faster while he stands in one. Tibo starts deep in the Mash Swamp.
content.dailyWeather.rings.name: Sprout Rings
content.dailyWeather.sandstorm.desc: Sand blows across the Fry-Oil Desert and piles into drifts that slow Tibo but not pests and bosses, and Tibo starts deep in the desert.
content.dailyWeather.sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
content.dailyWeather.sizes.desc: A quarter of the pests are giants with more health and experience, and a quarter are tiny and fast. Tibo starts deep in the Crop Circle.
content.dailyWeather.sizes.name: Odd Sizes
content.dailyWeather.snow.desc: Snow falls all run, everyone moves slower, frost patches spread twice as often, and Tibo starts deep in the Frozen-Fries Tundra.
content.dailyWeather.snow.name: Big Freeze
content.dailyWeather.storm.desc: Lightning strikes the thickest crowd near Tibo every few seconds, hurting and knocking back every pest and boss in the blast, and Tibo starts deep in the Ketchup Bog.
content.dailyWeather.storm.name: Thunderstorm
content.dailyWeather.swarm.desc: Every pest comes with a twin, so there are twice as many pests, each with half the health and half the experience. Tibo starts deep in the Potato Field.
content.dailyWeather.swarm.name: Swarm Day
content.dailyWeather.tilt.desc: The ground tilts and turns every 30 seconds, and pests and pickups slide downhill. Tibo starts deep in the Chip Canyons.
content.dailyWeather.tilt.name: Gravity Tilt
content.dailyWeather.warp.desc: Every 15 seconds time warps, and pests, bosses and enemy bullets move at half pace for 3 seconds. Tibo starts deep in the Compost Caves.
content.dailyWeather.warp.name: Time Warp
content.dog.beagle.desc: Points to the nearest crate, shrine or dog, and finds loose gold.
content.dog.beagle.name: Scout
content.dog.collie.desc: Every few seconds, shoves the enemies around you back.
content.dog.collie.name: Moss
content.dog.corgi.desc: Barks every few seconds and freezes nearby enemies (not bosses).
content.dog.corgi.name: Waffles
content.dog.dachshund.desc: Digs up gold every few seconds, and sometimes a snack or a reroll.
content.dog.dachshund.name: Frank
content.dog.dalmatian.desc: Bites a nearby enemy every 2 seconds and gives it one of your burns, slows or freezes.
content.dog.dalmatian.name: Sprinkles
content.dog.greyhound.desc: Every few seconds, sprints through a line of enemies and hurts them all.
content.dog.greyhound.name: Zoom
content.dog.husky.desc: Howls every few seconds, and every other dog in your pack acts at once.
content.dog.husky.name: Echo
content.dog.newfoundland.desc: Leaps at enemy shots that come close to you and catches them.
content.dog.newfoundland.name: Buoy
content.dog.pomchi.desc: Marks the nearest elite or loot runner so it takes more damage.
content.dog.pomchi.name: Zelda
content.dog.pomeranian.desc: His fluff takes the next hit on you, then he sneezes pests away.
content.dog.pomeranian.name: Link
content.dog.retriever.desc: Every few seconds, brings gems, gold and snacks to you from far away.
content.dog.retriever.name: Biscuit
content.dog.saint-bernard.desc: When your health drops low, runs to you and heals you.
content.dog.saint-bernard.name: Barrel
content.dog.saluki.desc: Runs at your heels and lunges at a pest every 2 seconds, harder the faster you move.
content.dog.saluki.name: Gale
content.dog.shiba.desc: When Tibo kills an elite, Kiko calls two spirit pups that hunt pests for 6 s.
content.dog.shiba.name: Kiko
content.dog.sigkitten.desc: Hacks the pests' shots: they slow down as they near you, so you have more time to dodge. SIGSTOP, kind of.
content.dog.sigkitten.name: SIGKITTEN
content.dog.terrier.desc: Darts at the nearest enemy and bites it, about once a second.
content.dog.terrier.name: Pip
content.dog.whippet.desc: When Tibo is hit, Whip tugs him a short dash away, once every 15 s.
content.dog.whippet.name: Whip
content.dog.zelda-and-link.desc: Link's fluff and Zelda's marks, plus an eclipse that shields you and marks every pest near you.
content.dog.zelda-and-link.name: Zelda & Link

content.item.all-seeing-spud.desc: 35% of kills send 4 potato eyes that pierce through enemies.
content.item.all-seeing-spud.name: All-Seeing Spud
content.item.baked-buckler.desc: Cuts the damage of each hit. Stronger enemies get through more.
content.item.baked-buckler.name: Baked Buckler
content.item.bonfire-spud.desc: 25% of hits set enemies on fire, and the fire spreads to the enemies around them.
content.item.bonfire-spud.name: Bonfire Spud

content.item.boss-buster.name: Boss Buster

content.item.copper-spoon.name: Copper Spoon

content.item.copper-tot.name: Copper Tot

content.item.crit-chip.name: Crit Chip
content.item.cursed-crown.name: Cursed Crown

content.item.freezer-burn.desc: Frozen enemies shatter when they die and freeze enemies nearby.
content.item.freezer-burn.name: Freezer Burn
content.item.frozen-pea.desc: 8% of hits freeze the enemy for 1 s. Bosses slow instead.
content.item.frozen-pea.name: Frozen Pea
content.item.fry-box.name: Fry Box
content.item.fry-fuel.desc: Every 30 kills refills one dash charge.
content.item.fry-fuel.name: Fry Fuel
content.item.fry-volcano.desc: When Tibo is hit, he erupts in a blast and fires 24 fries that pierce through enemies.
content.item.fry-volcano.name: Fry Volcano
content.item.ghost-pepper.desc: Tibo stays untouchable for 0.15 s after each dash ends.
content.item.ghost-pepper.name: Ghost Pepper
content.item.ghost-skin.desc: Raises the chance to dodge a hit. The higher your dodge chance, the less it adds.
content.item.ghost-skin.name: Ghost Skin
content.item.glacier-spud.desc: 30% of kills shatter, freezing nearby enemies and slowing the enemies around them.
content.item.glacier-spud.name: Glacier Spud
content.item.golden-gravy.name: Golden Gravy
content.item.heavy-russet.name: Heavy Russet
content.item.hot-pepper.desc: Raises crit chance. The higher your crit chance, the less it adds.
content.item.hot-pepper.name: Hot Pepper
content.item.kaboom-spud.desc: 25% of kills explode, hitting nearby enemies for half the dead enemy's max HP.
content.item.kaboom-spud.name: Kaboom Spud
content.item.lightning-spud.desc: 6% of hits call down lightning on the enemies around them.
content.item.lightning-spud.name: Lightning Spud
content.item.lucky-peel.name: Lucky Peel
content.item.magma-croquette.desc: 20% of hits erupt in a huge blast that sets enemies on fire.
content.item.magma-croquette.name: Magma Croquette
content.item.mash-crater.desc: Each dash lands in a wide mash crater that throws 8 hash browns outward.
content.item.mash-crater.name: Mash Crater
content.item.mash-splat.desc: Each dash lands in a mash splat that hits the enemies around Tibo.
content.item.mash-splat.name: Mash Splat
content.item.meteor-russet.desc: 3% of hits call down a meteor for 20× damage that also craters enemies around it.
content.item.meteor-russet.name: Meteor Russet
content.item.midnight-fries.desc: +5% damage. After 20:00, damage grows 6% more each minute.
content.item.midnight-fries.name: Midnight Fries
content.item.moon-dust.desc: 15% of kills burst into moon dust that slows enemies nearby.
content.item.moon-dust.name: Moon Dust
content.item.panic-fry.desc: The first time each minute Tibo drops below 50% HP, pests slow to nineteen-twentieths speed for 3 s and his hits deal a quarter more damage.
content.item.panic-fry.name: Panic Fry
content.item.penny-spud.name: Penny Spud
content.item.philosophers-potato.desc: +10% to damage, area, speed and duration.
content.item.philosophers-potato.name: Philosopher's Potato
content.item.pickle-jar.name: Pickle Jar
content.item.porcupine-spud.desc: When Tibo is hit, he fires 10 fries outward.
content.item.porcupine-spud.name: Porcupine Spud
content.item.potato-knish.name: Potato Knish
content.item.receipt-spud.desc: Each chest or crate you open gives +2% damage for the rest of the run.
content.item.receipt-spud.name: Receipt Spud
content.item.salt-crystal.name: Salt Crystal
content.item.second-helping.desc: Each snack Tibo eats at full HP gives +1% damage for the rest of the run, up to +10% per level.
content.item.second-helping.name: Second Helping
content.item.second-spud.name: Second Spud
content.item.sharp-peeler.name: Sharp Peeler
content.item.souffle-spud.desc: When Tibo is hit, he puffs up and shoves nearby enemies away.
content.item.souffle-spud.name: Soufflé Spud
content.item.spark-spud.desc: Walking charges a spark. Every 300 units Tibo walks, it bursts, hitting and stunning pests around him.
content.item.spark-spud.name: Spark Spud
content.item.spicy-croquette.desc: 12% of hits burst in a fiery blast.
content.item.spicy-croquette.name: Spicy Croquette
content.item.spud-muffin.name: Spud Muffin
content.item.spud-purse.desc: Every 100 units Tibo walks, he drops a coin, 16 units sooner per extra copy.
content.item.spud-purse.name: Spud Purse
content.item.spud-spring.desc: Cuts the dash cooldown by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times.
content.item.spud-spring.name: Spud Spring
content.item.starch-sock.name: Starch Sock
content.item.static-socks.desc: Each dash ends with a starch bolt on the 3 nearest enemies, 176 damage each.
content.item.static-socks.name: Static Socks
content.item.static-tot.desc: 10% of hits arc lightning to 3 more enemies.
content.item.static-tot.name: Static Tot
content.item.storm-tot.desc: 15% of hits arc lightning to 6 more enemies, with a thunderclap at each one.
content.item.storm-tot.name: Storm Tot
content.item.tailwind-tater.desc: +1% damage for every 2% move speed above base.
content.item.tailwind-tater.name: Tailwind Tater
content.item.tater-tank.name: Tater Tank
content.item.tater-treat.desc: Dogs use their abilities 25% more often.
content.item.tater-treat.name: Tater Treat
content.item.thorny-jacket.desc: Enemies that hit Tibo take 8 damage.
content.item.thorny-jacket.name: Thorny Jacket
content.item.time-tuber.name: Time Tuber
content.item.vampire-tot.name: Vampire Tot
content.item.wandering-eyes.desc: 20% of kills send 2 potato eyes after other enemies.
content.item.wandering-eyes.name: Wandering Eyes
content.item.warm-bowl.desc: Charging any activation ring leaves a healing pool there for 10 s.
content.item.warm-bowl.name: Warm Bowl
content.item.wide-ladle.name: Wide Ladle
content.passive.aged-russet.desc: +0.5% damage per level for each level Tibo has gained this run, up to +10% per level.
content.passive.aged-russet.name: Aged Russet
content.passive.bacon-bits.desc: +12% damage to elites and bosses per level.
content.passive.bacon-bits.name: Bacon Bits
content.passive.big-bowl.name: Big Bowl
content.passive.butter-pat.name: Butter Pat
content.passive.butter-socks.desc: +1 dash charge at levels 1, 3 and 5. Each level cuts the dash cooldown by 6%.
content.passive.butter-socks.name: Butter Socks
content.passive.chives.name: Chives
content.passive.clean-plate.desc: After 5 s without a hit, +12% crit chance per level. A hit sheds one level.
content.passive.clean-plate.name: Clean Plate
content.passive.couch-potato.desc: While Tibo stands still, damage rises 4% a second per level, up to 20% per level. Moving resets it.
content.passive.couch-potato.name: Couch Potato
content.passive.fertilizer.name: Fertilizer
content.passive.four-eyed-spud.desc: +10% luck per level. Shot weapons fire +1 projectile at levels 2 and 4.
content.passive.four-eyed-spud.name: Four-Eyed Spud
content.passive.golden-fry.name: Golden Fry
content.passive.gpu.desc: +1 projectile. Firing builds heat. At full heat, weapons fire at half speed for 3s. Each level adds fire rate and cooling.
content.passive.gpu.name: GPU
content.passive.gravy-heart.name: Gravy Heart
content.passive.gravy-splash.desc: Every 0.5 s, the HP Tibo healed splashes out as damage to nearby enemies: 100% of it per level.
content.passive.gravy-splash.name: Gravy Splash
content.passive.hash-rush.desc: Each dash in the last 4 s adds 4% damage per level, counting up to 3 dashes.
content.passive.hash-rush.name: Hash Rush
content.passive.hearty-helping.desc: +2% damage for every 50 max HP Tibo gains above his starting max HP. Each level adds another 2% per 50.
content.passive.hearty-helping.name: Hearty Helping
content.passive.hot-sauce.desc: Raises crit chance with each level. The higher your crit chance, the less each level adds.
content.passive.hot-sauce.name: Hot Sauce
content.passive.hot-start.desc: After each dash, every weapon reloads 60% faster for 1.3 s. Each level adds 0.3 s. Tibo glows while it lasts.
content.passive.hot-start.name: Hot Start
content.passive.lean-lunch.desc: +4% damage and -2% cooldown per level for each empty weapon slot.
content.passive.lean-lunch.name: Lean Lunch
content.passive.mash-finisher.desc: A hit mashes any pest left below 2% of its max HP per level, up to 15%. Elites mash at half that. Bosses never do.
content.passive.mash-finisher.name: Mash Finisher
content.passive.masher-grip.name: Masher Grip
content.passive.packed-pan.desc: +1% damage for each pest inside Tibo's pickup range, up to 10 pests. Each level adds another 1% per pest.
content.passive.packed-pan.name: Packed Pan
content.passive.peel-out.desc: After Tibo dodges a hit, his weapons deal double damage for 2 s. Peels spin around him while it lasts.
content.passive.peel-out.name: Peel Out
content.passive.potato-magnet.name: Potato Magnet
content.passive.root-network.name: Root Network
content.passive.rotten-spud.desc: +10% curse per level: stronger, faster, more enemies, but more XP and gold.
content.passive.rotten-spud.name: Rotten Spud
content.passive.salt-shaker.name: Salt Shaker
content.passive.slow-cooker.name: Slow Cooker
content.passive.sour-cream.name: Sour Cream
content.passive.sprouting-eyes.name: Sprouting Eyes
content.passive.spry-sprout.desc: Each level cuts the dash cooldown by 5%.
content.passive.spry-sprout.name: Spry Sprout
content.passive.spud-sneakers.name: Spud Sneakers
content.passive.starch-plating.desc: Cuts the damage of each hit, more with each level. Stronger enemies get through more.
content.passive.starch-plating.name: Starch Plating
content.passive.stuffed-skin.name: Stuffed Skin
content.passive.tater-trot.desc: Each 1% of bonus move speed adds 1% fire rate, up to 8% per level.
content.passive.tater-trot.name: Tater Trot
content.passive.thick-skin.desc: Raises the chance to dodge a hit with each level. The higher your dodge chance, the less each level adds.
content.passive.thick-skin.name: Thick Skin
content.poi.bossLair.desc: A boss sleeps here. It guards a big chest.
content.poi.bossLair.name: Boss Lair
content.poi.botDock.desc: Stand by it to call a swarm of Grok Bots.
content.poi.botDock.name: Bot Dock
content.poi.chargeShrine.desc: Stand inside to charge it, then pick a stat.
content.poi.chargeShrine.name: Spud Shrine
content.poi.crops.desc: Break it for gold and a snack.
content.poi.crops.name: Crop Patch
content.poi.curseShrine.desc: Take curse for a pile of gold. Curses bring extra elites and bosses.
content.poi.curseShrine.name: Moldy Shrine
content.poi.dinnerBell.desc: Ring it to call a ring of pests. They drop triple XP.
content.poi.dinnerBell.name: Dinner Bell
content.poi.dog.desc: A good dog looking for a friend. Walk up to it.
content.poi.dog.name: Stray Dog
content.poi.dogKennel.desc: Stand by it to buy up to three levels for your dogs.
content.poi.dogKennel.name: Dog Kennel
content.poi.eliteNest.desc: An elite waits here. It drops a chest.
content.poi.eliteNest.name: Beetle Nest
content.poi.frenzyFryer.desc: Stand by it for a 20 s frenzy.
content.poi.frenzyFryer.name: Frenzy Fryer
content.poi.goldenShrine.desc: Stand by it to charge it, then pick a big blessing.
content.poi.goldenShrine.name: Golden Spud Shrine
content.poi.microwave.desc: Stand by it to charge it, then copy one of your items. The copy melts another item of the same rarity.
content.poi.microwave.name: Microwave
content.poi.paidChest.desc: Costs gold. Holds an item. Each crate costs more than the last.
content.poi.paidChest.name: Potato Crate
content.poi.rootTunnel.desc: Stand by it to tunnel to a far place.
content.poi.rootTunnel.name: Root Tunnel
content.poi.seedVault.desc: Stand by it to charge it for rerolls, a skip and a banish.
content.poi.seedVault.name: Seed Vault
content.poi.spudFreezer.desc: Stand by it to freeze every enemy on the map for 7.5 s. Bosses only slow down.
content.poi.spudFreezer.name: Spud Freezer
content.poi.taterLantern.name: Tater Lantern
content.poi.taterMagnet.desc: Stand by it to pull in every gem and coin.
content.poi.taterMagnet.name: Tater Magnet
content.poi.taterSlots.desc: Pay gold to spin. Match two for an item.
content.poi.taterSlots.name: Tater Slots
content.poi.vendor.name: Fry Cart
content.poi.whetstone.desc: Stand by it to charge it, then level up one of your weapons.
content.poi.whetstone.name: Spud Whetstone

content.varietyPlace.chili-bottle.desc: Pick it up to breathe fire where Tibo faces for 10 s. The fire grows with his damage and area.
content.varietyPlace.chili-bottle.name: Chili Bottle
content.varietyPlace.dig-spot.desc: Stand on the X to dig up a chest.
content.varietyPlace.dig-spot.name: X Marks the Spot
content.varietyPlace.lighthouse.desc: Stand by it to light it. Crabs swarm in, and a chest lands at its foot.
content.varietyPlace.lighthouse.name: Lighthouse
content.varietyPlace.mash-bomb.desc: Break it to flatten every pest on screen. Elites and bosses lose a fifth of their max HP.
content.varietyPlace.mash-bomb.name: Mash Bomb
content.varietyPlace.rowboat.desc: Stand in it to row to the far shore.
content.varietyPlace.rowboat.name: Rowboat
content.varietyPlace.treasure-map.desc: Read it to mark an X. Dig at the X for a chest.
content.varietyPlace.treasure-map.name: Treasure Map
content.weapon.afterburner-fries.desc: Each dash blasts a fan of hot fries backward from where the dash started.
content.weapon.afterburner-fries.name: Afterburner Fries
content.weapon.baked-alaska.desc: A hot potato that freezes each enemy it hops to. Frozen enemies take double damage. Its last hop shatters every frozen enemy nearby and throws two fresh hot potatoes. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.baked-alaska.name: Baked Alaska
content.weapon.big-fry.desc: The fry pierces everything and grows bigger as it grows stronger.
content.weapon.big-fry.name: Big Fry
content.weapon.bottomless-sack.desc: Pulls two snacks at a time, and they come out evolved.
content.weapon.bottomless-sack.name: Bottomless Sack
content.weapon.broadside.desc: Fires a row of powder shells out of both sides of Tibo, square to the way he runs. Each shell bursts on the first pest it meets or where it lands.
content.weapon.broadside.name: Broadside
content.weapon.butter-streak.desc: Each dash leaves a strip of melted butter that slows pests and burns them for 2 s. Between dashes, it also leaves one on the path Tibo just walked.
content.weapon.butter-streak.name: Butter Streak
content.weapon.cast-iron.desc: Swings both ways. Swatted bullets hit harder, pierce, and home in on pests. Each elite kill charges the next swing.
content.weapon.cast-iron.name: Cast Iron
content.weapon.chip-shuriken.name: Chip Shuriken
content.weapon.clockwork-spud.desc: Tibo plants wind-up spuds behind him, and pests nearby walk to them. Each burst leaves a smaller spud that winds up and bursts once more.
content.weapon.clockwork-spud.name: Clockwork Spud
content.weapon.cold-frame.desc: Sprouts circle Tibo forever inside a wide cold ring. Pests that cross the ring or meet a sprout freeze for a moment. Bosses only slow. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.cold-frame.name: Cold Frame
content.weapon.cold-storage.desc: A wider, colder ring. Pests freeze longer and take harder frostbite.
content.weapon.cold-storage.name: Cold Storage
content.weapon.comet-scythe.desc: A scythe blade circles Tibo. Every two laps its orbit swings out wide and pulls back in close, so it cuts both the pests at Tibo's feet and the ring beyond them.
content.weapon.comet-scythe.name: Comet Scythe
content.weapon.deep-fryer.desc: Sprays hot oil in a cone.
content.weapon.deep-fryer.name: Deep Fryer
content.weapon.eclipse-scythe.desc: Sun and moon blades circle Tibo. While the sun blades swing out wide, the moon blades cut close at his feet, then they trade places, so pests near and far are always in reach.
content.weapon.eclipse-scythe.name: Eclipse Scythe
content.weapon.eternal-sprouts.name: Eternal Sprouts
content.weapon.factory-reset.desc: A full reset. Clears the screen, keeps the drops, heals Tibo.
content.weapon.factory-reset.name: Factory Reset
content.weapon.frozen-fries.desc: Shoots frozen fries that freeze enemies in place.
content.weapon.frozen-fries.name: Frozen Fries
content.weapon.fry-brigade.desc: Tot pups in fry-cook hats follow Tibo, shoot, and plant fry turrets as they go. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.fry-brigade.name: Fry Brigade
content.weapon.fry-by.desc: Fries spray behind Tibo while he runs. Each dash blasts a wide double fan of fries back along his path, and every fan fry splashes hot oil where it lands. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.fry-by.name: Fry-By
content.weapon.fry-fortress.desc: Drops three armored fry turrets at a time. They stand longer and their crinkle fries pierce.
content.weapon.fry-fortress.name: Fry Fortress
content.weapon.fry-knives.desc: Fires sharp fries in the direction Tibo faces.
content.weapon.fry-knives.name: Fry Knives
content.weapon.fry-lance.desc: One very long fry that pierces a whole line.
content.weapon.fry-lance.name: Fry Lance
content.weapon.fry-sentry.desc: Drops a fry-cook turret that shoots nearby enemies.
content.weapon.fry-sentry.name: Fry Cook Sentry
content.weapon.frying-pan.desc: Swings a pan in front of Tibo. Enemy bullets it swats fly back at whoever shot them. Each elite Tibo kills charges the next swing bigger and harder.
content.weapon.frying-pan.name: Frying Pan
content.weapon.full-broadside.desc: Fires two rows of powder shells out of both sides of Tibo. Each shell bursts on the first pest it meets or where it lands, and throws three small shells that burst where they land.
content.weapon.full-broadside.name: Full Broadside
content.weapon.gem-catapult.desc: Each XP gem Tibo picks up flings a potato wedge along his heading, with each wedge hitting far harder. More amount flings more wedges in a fan.
content.weapon.gem-catapult.name: Gem Catapult
content.weapon.gem-sling.desc: Each XP gem Tibo picks up flings a potato wedge along his heading. More amount flings more wedges in a fan.
content.weapon.gem-sling.name: Gem Sling
content.weapon.ghee-glide.desc: Each dash leaves a strip of hot ghee that slows and burns pests. Between dashes, it also leaves one on the path Tibo just walked. Tibo walks 15% faster on the ghee.
content.weapon.ghee-glide.name: Ghee Glide
content.weapon.golden-harvest.desc: A downpour of golden potatoes. Kills can drop gold.
content.weapon.golden-harvest.name: Golden Harvest
content.weapon.grab-bag.desc: Reaches into a sack and fires a different weapon's attack every time.
content.weapon.grab-bag.name: Grab Bag
content.weapon.gratin-arc.desc: A cheesy arc that chains far and crits often.
content.weapon.gratin-arc.name: Gratin Arc
content.weapon.gravy-boat.desc: Pours scalding gravy pools on enemies.
content.weapon.gravy-boat.name: Gravy Boat
content.weapon.gravy-flood.desc: Gravy pools grow and drift after Tibo.
content.weapon.gravy-flood.name: Gravy Flood
content.weapon.gravy-pack.desc: Four gravy-glazed tot pups run with Tibo. Each bite heals him 0.05 HP.
content.weapon.gravy-pack.name: Gravy Pack
content.weapon.gravy-whirlpool.desc: Scalding gravy whirlpools drag in crowds and burn them. They grow, drift after Tibo and slam their catch. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.gravy-whirlpool.name: Gravy Whirlpool
content.weapon.grease-fire.desc: Wildfire Roast's sweep sprays a huge cloud of burning fryer oil, and the flames at Tibo's feet light the oil into burning puddles as he runs. Each flame he keeps lit makes the sweep reach much farther, up to five. A hit puts out two flames, and a stop puts them all out. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.grease-fire.name: Grease Fire
content.weapon.griddle-guard.desc: Hash browns circle Tibo and block hits and bullets. Where one blocks a bullet, the pan swings there and swats it back at the shooter. Broken hash browns burst into freezing shards, and the pan swings both ways. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.griddle-guard.name: Griddle Guard
content.weapon.harvest-moon.desc: A moon spud circles Tibo. Each pest it touches rides its orbit for a moment, then is flung out and hit. A flung pest cannot be caught again for a few seconds, and bosses are too heavy to catch.
content.weapon.harvest-moon.name: Harvest Moon
content.weapon.hash-boomerang.desc: A crispy hash brown that flies out and comes back.
content.weapon.hash-boomerang.name: Hash Boomerang
content.weapon.hash-brown-shield.desc: Hash browns circle Tibo. Each takes up to 20 damage of one hit or bullet, then bursts into shards that hurt nearby enemies. Thorns add to shard damage. Broken ones re-crisp one at a time.
content.weapon.hash-brown-shield.name: Hash Brown Shield
content.weapon.hash-bulwark.desc: More hash browns that re-crisp faster and take up to 30 damage of a hit. Their shards hit harder and freeze enemies.
content.weapon.hash-bulwark.name: Hash Bulwark
content.weapon.hash-carousel.desc: Golden hash-brown wheels circle Tibo and throw hash browns that fly out and back. They spin and throw as fast as he runs, and slow to a crawl when he stands still. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.hash-carousel.name: Hash Carousel
content.weapon.hash-harrier.desc: Ember-winged hash-brown harriers circle above Tibo and dive on the toughest pest in reach, a boss first, then an elite. Each dive leaves burning hash crumbs that scorch pests standing on them.
content.weapon.hash-harrier.name: Hash Harrier
content.weapon.hash-hawk.desc: A hash-brown hawk circles above Tibo. Every few seconds it dives on the toughest pest in reach, a boss first, then an elite, and strikes everything beside it.
content.weapon.hash-hawk.name: Hash Hawk
content.weapon.hashnado.desc: Hash browns spin out in a crispy storm and return.
content.weapon.hashnado.name: Hashnado
content.weapon.hot-potato.desc: Hops from pest to pest and blows up on the last one when its count runs out.
content.weapon.hot-potato.name: Hot Potato
content.weapon.hot-streak.desc: A fry-oil slash sweeps the pests around Tibo. Every second that Tibo keeps moving without being hit lights a flame at his feet, up to five, and each flame makes the slash reach farther and come faster. A hit puts out two flames, and a stop puts them all out.
content.weapon.hot-streak.name: Hot Streak
content.weapon.hungry-sprouts.desc: Homing sprouts that split when they hit and gain damage with every kill they make, for the rest of the run. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.hungry-sprouts.name: Hungry Sprouts
content.weapon.hunters-moon.desc: Bigger moon spuds circle Tibo and catch pests from farther out. Each flung pest bursts into moon dust where it lands and hits the pests around it. Bosses are too heavy to catch.
content.weapon.hunters-moon.name: Hunter's Moon
content.weapon.inferno-basket.desc: A long blast of fryer oil. Double damage to elites and bosses.
content.weapon.inferno-basket.name: Inferno Basket
content.weapon.jet-fryer.desc: Each dash blasts two fans of hot fries backward from where the dash started. Every fry splashes hot oil where it lands.
content.weapon.jet-fryer.name: Jet Fryer
content.weapon.julienne-dash.desc: Each dash slices every pest along Tibo's path. Between dashes, it also slices along the path he just walked.
content.weapon.julienne-dash.name: Julienne Dash
content.weapon.kettle-cyclone.name: Kettle Cyclone
content.weapon.knife-block.desc: Slices in front of Tibo and behind him at once and flings potato slices both ways. Each slash hit heals Tibo a little, and the more HP Tibo is missing, the harder it hits. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.knife-block.name: Knife Block
content.weapon.landmine-harvest.desc: Rotten mines. Enemies they kill drop extra gold.
content.weapon.landmine-harvest.name: Landmine Harvest
content.weapon.loaded-dice.desc: Rolls two dice and keeps the higher. A pair doubles the throw.
content.weapon.loaded-dice.name: Loaded Dice
content.weapon.locked-gatling.desc: Each 2 second burst locks onto the nearest pest's angle and keeps firing tots that way while Tibo moves. More amount fires more lanes side by side.
content.weapon.locked-gatling.name: Locked Gatling
content.weapon.loot-sling.desc: Pulls two evolved snacks from the sack at a time, and each XP gem Tibo picks up flings one more along his heading. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.loot-sling.name: Loot Sling
content.weapon.mandoline-fury.desc: Slices both ways at once and flings potato slices through the crowd. Each slash hit heals Tibo a little.
content.weapon.mandoline-fury.name: Mandoline Fury
content.weapon.mash-avalanche.desc: The mash ball hits harder, and on its first hit it breaks into three smaller balls that fan out along its heading and splatter pests by their size.
content.weapon.mash-avalanche.name: Mash Avalanche
content.weapon.mash-colossus.desc: A bigger golem of mash stomps the way Tibo faces. Each step leaves a patch of mash that slows pests, and its last slam sends a ring of mash rolling out.
content.weapon.mash-colossus.name: Mash Colossus
content.weapon.mash-golem.desc: A golem of mash rises in front of Tibo and stomps the way he faces, shoving pests out of its path to open a lane. At the end of its walk it slams the ground and crumbles.
content.weapon.mash-golem.name: Mash Golem
content.weapon.mash-landing.desc: Each dash ends in a mash shockwave that hits every pest around Tibo and shoves it back.
content.weapon.mash-landing.name: Mash Landing
content.weapon.mash-meteor.desc: Each dash ends in a bigger mash shockwave, and a second, wider ring follows a moment later.
content.weapon.mash-meteor.name: Mash Meteor
content.weapon.mash-snowball.desc: A ball of mash rolls behind Tibo and grows with every step he runs. When he stops or turns hard, it surges ahead along his last heading and splatters pests by its size. A full ball lets go on its own.
content.weapon.mash-snowball.name: Mash Snowball
content.weapon.mash-wave.desc: A ring of mashed potato rolls out from Tibo.
content.weapon.mash-wave.name: Mash Wave
content.weapon.mashquake.desc: Mash rolls out in waves that slow what they hit. Each wave flings clumps of mash across the field.
content.weapon.mashquake.name: Mashquake
content.weapon.mezzaluna.desc: Chops in front of Tibo and behind him. The more HP Tibo is missing, the harder it hits.
content.weapon.mezzaluna.name: Mezzaluna
content.weapon.moon-cleaver.desc: Chops twice in front and once behind, and flicks hash shreds back through the crowd. The more HP Tibo is missing, the harder it hits.
content.weapon.moon-cleaver.name: Moon Cleaver
content.weapon.overgrowth.desc: Seeker sprouts that split when they hit.
content.weapon.overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
content.weapon.peel-phantom.desc: Each dash leaves a peel husk of Tibo where the dash began. Nearby pests chase the husk until it bursts.
content.weapon.peel-phantom.name: Peel Phantom
content.weapon.peel-poltergeist.desc: Each dash leaves a haunted peel husk where the dash began. Pests chase it into its spinning peels, then it bursts into a ring of peels.
content.weapon.peel-poltergeist.name: Peel Poltergeist
content.weapon.peeler.desc: Slashes sideways. From level 4 it flings potato peels through the crowd, one more each level. Tibo's trusty kitchen tool.
content.weapon.peeler.name: Peeler
content.weapon.permafrost-fries.desc: Freezes longer. Frozen enemies take double damage.
content.weapon.permafrost-fries.name: Permafrost Fries
content.weapon.potato-battery.desc: Clips a live wire onto a pest. The wire zaps and slows every pest it touches. The clipped pest can't die until the wire lets go.
content.weapon.potato-battery.name: Potato Battery
content.weapon.potato-patch.desc: Tibo tosses three fertilized seed potatoes at a time, and up to six grow at once. Their zaps and harvest bursts hit much harder. Walk over a plant to harvest it and throw again.
content.weapon.potato-patch.name: Potato Patch
content.weapon.potato-rain.desc: Calls down a shower of potatoes around Tibo.
content.weapon.potato-rain.name: Potato Rain
content.weapon.pressure-cooker.desc: A huge steam cloud. Each enemy it burns heals Tibo.
content.weapon.pressure-cooker.name: Pressure Cooker
content.weapon.railfry.desc: Three lances that cross the whole view.
content.weapon.railfry.name: Railfry
content.weapon.reset-button.desc: We reset the limits. Clears every enemy on screen. Bosses only flinch.
content.weapon.reset-button.name: Reset Button
content.weapon.root-cellar.desc: A ring of cellar cold around Tibo. Pests that cross it take frostbite and freeze for a moment. Bosses only slow.
content.weapon.root-cellar.name: Root Cellar
content.weapon.root-current.desc: Clips three live wires. Every second, roots burst under each wired pest, throw pests back and carry the zap to every pest they hit. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.root-current.name: Root Current
content.weapon.root-legion.desc: More seedlings sprout and live longer, and a new one rises beside Tibo every half second. Each seedling that wilts leaves a root snare that holds pests in place for a moment.
content.weapon.root-legion.name: Root Legion
content.weapon.root-spikes.desc: Roots burst out of the ground under enemies.
content.weapon.root-spikes.name: Root Spikes
content.weapon.rosti-disc.desc: A flat rösti that bounces off the edges of the view.
content.weapon.rosti-disc.name: Rösti Disc
content.weapon.rosti-storm.desc: Bouncing röstis that burst at every bounce.
content.weapon.rosti-storm.name: Rösti Storm
content.weapon.russet-ricochet.desc: Russet cannonballs skip out in a fan along the way Tibo faces and burst at every bounce, each burst bigger than the last. Every burst throws a small spud at a nearby pest, and the spud bursts too. Amount adds a bounce.
content.weapon.russet-ricochet.name: Russet Ricochet
content.weapon.sack-of-russets.desc: A whole sack of heavy potatoes, all at once.
content.weapon.sack-of-russets.name: Sack of Russets
content.weapon.salt-flats.desc: A wider salt trail that slows pests harder and pushes them out of Tibo's path.
content.weapon.salt-flats.name: Salt Flats
content.weapon.salt-line.desc: Tibo trails salt while he walks. Pests on the salt are slowed and stung.
content.weapon.salt-line.name: Salt Line
content.weapon.salted-butter.desc: Every step and every dash leaves salted butter that stings and slows pests, pushes them out of Tibo's path and sets them burning. Tibo walks 15% faster on it. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.salted-butter.name: Salted Butter
content.weapon.seed-potato.desc: Tibo tosses a seed potato onto the nearest crowd. It sprouts in three stages and zaps pests around it every second. Walk over it to harvest a burst that grows with the stage and catch the potato to throw again. Left alone, it bursts weakly after 8 s.
content.weapon.seed-potato.name: Seed Potato
content.weapon.seeker-sprouts.name: Seeker Sprouts
content.weapon.skipping-cannonball.desc: A cannonball skips along the way Tibo faces and bursts at every bounce, each burst bigger than the last. Amount adds a bounce.
content.weapon.skipping-cannonball.name: Skipping Cannonball
content.weapon.small-fry.desc: A tiny fry that starts weak and gains damage with every kill it makes, for the rest of the run.
content.weapon.small-fry.name: Small Fry
content.weapon.sowing-season.desc: Golden potatoes rain down, and each one that misses stays planted as a mine. Kills can drop gold. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.sowing-season.name: Sowing Season
content.weapon.spark-corral.desc: Every 60 units Tibo walks, he plants a charged starch post. A braided arc twice as wide runs between the posts and zaps pests much harder. More posts stand, and each lasts 9 s.
content.weapon.spark-corral.name: Spark Corral
content.weapon.spicy-hot-potato.desc: Hops further, and its blast throws two fresh hot potatoes.
content.weapon.spicy-hot-potato.name: Spicy Hot Potato
content.weapon.sprout-satellites.desc: Potato sprouts circle Tibo for a while.
content.weapon.sprout-satellites.name: Sprout Satellites
content.weapon.sprout-squad.desc: A pest that falls can sprout a seedling where it fell. Each seedling hops to the nearest pest and bites it until it wilts. More amount lets more seedlings grow at once.
content.weapon.sprout-squad.name: Sprout Squad
content.weapon.spud-artillery.desc: A barrage of lobbed potatoes that explode. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.spud-artillery.name: Spud Artillery
content.weapon.spud-cannon.desc: A classic potato gun. Shots burst on impact.
content.weapon.spud-cannon.name: Spud Cannon
content.weapon.spud-decoy.desc: Every few seconds Tibo plants a wind-up spud behind him. Pests nearby walk to it instead of him, and then it bursts.
content.weapon.spud-decoy.name: Spud Decoy
content.weapon.spud-dice.desc: Throws a potato die. 1 is a dud, 2 freezes, 3 burns, 4 splits, 5 pays gold, 6 blows up big.
content.weapon.spud-dice.name: Spud Dice
content.weapon.spud-fence.desc: Every 60 units Tibo walks, he plants a starch post. A live arc runs from each post to the one before and zaps pests that cross it. At most four posts stand, and a still Tibo plants none.
content.weapon.spud-fence.name: Spud Fence
content.weapon.spud-grid.desc: Clips three live wires at once. Each wire zaps harder and bursts when it lets go.
content.weapon.spud-grid.name: Spud Grid
content.weapon.spud-lob.desc: Lobs heavy potatoes high. They crash down through crowds.
content.weapon.spud-lob.name: Spud Lob
content.weapon.spudzooka.desc: Big potato rockets that split into cluster bursts.
content.weapon.spudzooka.name: Spudzooka
content.weapon.stand-mixer.desc: Two whirlpools pull harder. When one ends, it slams its catch together.
content.weapon.stand-mixer.name: Stand Mixer
content.weapon.starch-bolt.desc: Static from a pile of starch strikes random enemies.
content.weapon.starch-bolt.name: Starch Bolt
content.weapon.starch-chain.desc: A spark that jumps from enemy to enemy.
content.weapon.starch-chain.name: Starch Chain
content.weapon.starch-garden.desc: Tibo tosses fertilized seed potatoes onto crowds, and every 60 units he walks he plants a starch post with a seed potato at its foot. Every plant grows in three stages and zaps pests around it, and the arcs between posts grow stronger with their plants. Walk over a plant to harvest a burst. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.starch-garden.name: Starch Garden
content.weapon.starch-supercell.desc: Lightning that chains between enemies. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.starch-supercell.name: Starch Supercell
content.weapon.steam-vent.desc: Hot steam from a baked potato hurts everything close.
content.weapon.steam-vent.name: Steam Vent
content.weapon.tailgate-fries.desc: While Tibo runs, fries spray out behind him into whatever is chasing him. Standing still, he drips one fry behind him.
content.weapon.tailgate-fries.name: Tailgate Fries
content.weapon.tailgate-party.desc: Buttered fries spray out behind Tibo while he runs and hit much harder. Standing still, he drips one behind him.
content.weapon.tailgate-party.name: Tailgate Party
content.weapon.taproot-eruption.desc: Giant roots erupt and throw enemies back.
content.weapon.taproot-eruption.name: Taproot Eruption
content.weapon.tater-mines.desc: Buries spuds that burst when enemies step close.
content.weapon.tater-mines.name: Tater Mines
content.weapon.tater-minigun.desc: The same locked 2 second bursts, one lane per amount, with each tot hitting far harder.
content.weapon.tater-minigun.name: Tater Minigun
content.weapon.tater-pup.desc: A loyal tot that follows Tibo and shoots.
content.weapon.tater-pup.name: Tater Tot Pup
content.weapon.tater-twirl.desc: Hash-brown wheels circle Tibo, spinning and hitting as fast as he runs. When he stands still they slow to a crawl.
content.weapon.tater-twirl.name: Tater Twirl
content.weapon.tater-twister.desc: More hash-brown wheels circle Tibo on a wider orbit and hit harder, spinning as fast as he runs. When he stands still they slow to a crawl.
content.weapon.tater-twister.name: Tater Twister
content.weapon.thousand-fries.name: Thousand Fries
content.weapon.thunder-tuber.name: Thunder Tuber
content.weapon.tot-barrage.desc: A nonstop stream of tater tots. Each tot that hits pops out a tot that charges the next pest, and walking sends squads of charging tots out behind Tibo. Frees a weapon slot.
content.weapon.tot-barrage.name: Tot Barrage
content.weapon.tot-cavalry.desc: Every 40 units Tibo walks, a squad of buttered tater tots charges out behind him and rams through two pests each. A still Tibo makes no tots.
content.weapon.tot-cavalry.name: Tot Cavalry
content.weapon.tot-gatling.desc: A nonstop stream of tater tots.
content.weapon.tot-gatling.name: Tot Gatling
content.weapon.tot-stampede.desc: Every 40 units Tibo walks, a tater tot hops out behind him and charges the nearest pest, popping on contact. A still Tibo makes no tots.
content.weapon.tot-stampede.name: Tot Stampede
content.weapon.tot-toss.desc: Throws tater tots at the nearest enemy.
content.weapon.tot-toss.name: Tot Toss
content.weapon.waffle-cut.desc: Each dash cuts a cross through every pest along Tibo's path, then cuts it twice more, 0.5 s apart. Between dashes, it also cuts along the path he just walked.
content.weapon.waffle-cut.name: Waffle Cut
content.weapon.whisk-vortex.desc: Spins a whisk whirlpool under the biggest crowd and drags pests into it.
content.weapon.whisk-vortex.name: Whisk Vortex
content.weapon.wildfire-roast.desc: Hot Streak's slash burns white-hot. Each flame Tibo keeps lit makes the sweep reach much farther, up to five. A hit puts out two flames, and a stop puts them all out.
content.weapon.wildfire-roast.name: Wildfire Roast
